name: Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation
source:
Spooky ghost disrupts cute couple's onsen date. The last straw: "MY FOOD!!!"

Yuri game in a magical world where a couple has a vacation at an onsen, but encounters some spooky supernatural events. They spend the trip trying to chase down the cause, and it turns out it's a magical dog whose powers have run amok!

[From [url=https://quill-studios.itch.io/death-becomes-you-yuri-onsen-vacation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
幽灵扰乱了可爱情侣的温泉约会。最后一根稻草：“我的食物！！！”

尤里游戏发生在一个神奇的世界里，一对夫妇在温泉度假，但却遇到了一些诡异的超自然事件。他们一路上试图追查原因，结果发现这是一只神奇的狗，它的力量已经失控了！

[来自[url=https://quill-studios.itch.io/death-becomes-you-yuri-onsen-vacation]itch.io[/url]]
